item.title: Montreal shooting survivor shares how she regained sense of safety
item.description: TORONTO — École Polytechnique shooting survivor Nathalie Provost says it took her several weeks to return to the site of the Montreal massacre, but doing so allowed her to reclaim her life and create a sense of safety again. She was shot in the leg, foot and forehead by a gunman who killed 14 women […]

item.title: A timeline of how the Tumbler Ridge shootings unfolded
item.description: The following timeline of February 10th's shootings in Tumbler Ridge is based on information from the RCMP, B.C. government officials and BC Emergency Health Services.

item.title: (UPDATE) 18-year-old confirmed as Tumbler Ridge school shooter
item.description: The identity of the shooter who killed nine people in Tumbler Ridge has been confirmed as Jesse Van Rootselaar.

item.title: Tumbler Ridge PAC collects more than $68K to help families affected in school shooting
item.description: A GoFundMe page launched by the Tumbler Ridge PAC for victims of the deadly mass shooting in the community on February 10th has raised more than $68,000 on February 11th.

item.title: B.C. throne speech cancelled after Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.description: British Columbia's provincial legislature has cancelled Thursday's throne speech because of the mass shooting that claimed nine lives in Tumbler Ridge on February 10th.

item.title: CIBC donates $100,000 in response to deadly Tumbler Ridge mass shooting
item.description: CIBC said the funds will go to the CIBC Foundation's B.C. Emergency Relief Fund and support local efforts to help those directly impacted by the Tumbler Ridge shooting.

item.title: Google Maps blurs home involved in Tumbler Ridge shooter’s spree
item.description: BC RCMP deputy commissioner Dwayne McDonald revealed a location connected to the Tumbler Ridge Secondary School shooting on February 10th.

item.title: Families of child victims of Tumbler Ridge shooting launch fundraisers
item.description: Two GoFundMe campaigns have been launched to support the families of 12-year-olds affected by the shooting in Tumbler Ridge on February 10th.

item.title: Pictures from Tumbler Ridge as community mourns eight victims of shooting
item.description: See the scene in Tumbler Ridge as the community reels from a deadly school shooting on February 10th, 2026.

item.title: ‘Never think it could happen here’: Tumbler Ridge man tells of shock at victim count after deadly mass shooting
item.description: Kyle McKenzie, whose grandchild attends Tumbler Ridge Secondary School where the deadly shooting took place, recounted what he experienced on February 10th.
